name: Langen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Langen (a red wheel on yellow above a black base with a sail and waves).
history: Flag of a former municipality: the city of Langen merged with the Samtgemeinde Bederkesa into the city of Geestland on 1 January 2015.

features.role: Langen arms — wheel, sail and waves
